eps.o: The Motor City Machine Guns' Alex Shelley brings his veteran experience to a clash with Los Garza's Angel. Joaquin Wilde of the LWO looks to match speed and creativity with Bravo Americano in a high-flying encounter.
The MFT’s Talla Tonga imposes his presence in a test of strength against Apollo Crews. A tag team throwdown pits The War Raiders’ power against the aerial skill of Los Americanos.
"The Mad Dragon" Ilja Dragunov turns up the heat against Kit Wilson. Alpha Academy's Otis & Akira Tozowa battle American Made's Creed Brothers.

Rey Fenix and Fraxiom's Nathan Frazer take to the sky in a battle between two of WWE's highest flyers. Ireland's own Lyra Valkyria tangles with the powerhouse of American Made, Ivy Nile. American Alpha's Akira Tozawa and "The Aussie Icon" Grayson Waller collide.

Kit Wilson looks to put an end to Apollo Crews' "toxic masculinity" in a one-on-one showdown. Alpha Academy's Maxxine Dupri squares off with the powerhouse of American Made, Ivy Nile. The highflying Joaquin Wilde faces Rusev in a battle of contrasting styles.

Rusev aims to crush The LWO's Joaquin Wilde. Alpha Academy and American Made collide in tag team throwdown. Los Americanos strive to prove their lucha libre greatness in a battle against Motor City Machine Guns.
Dragon Lee aims to silence "The Aussie Icon" Grayson Waller. LWO collide with American Made in a clash of contrasting wrestling styles. Apollo Crews takes on Berto.

Jordynne Grace collides with Kiana James in a battle of strength and confidence. The LWO square off with Los Americanos in a heated tag team showdown. Lyra Valkyria meets Ivy Nile in a clash of technique and power.
Maxxine Dupri battles Roxanne Perez, Giulia tangles with Jordynne Grace, and NXT's Dorian Van Dux faces Rayo Americano on WWE Main Event.
Bayley and Lyra Valkyria take on Kali Armstrong and Layla Diggs, Otis battles Harlem Lewis, and Jordynne Grace collides with Kiana James.
Women's Intercontinental Champion Sol Ruca takes on Nattie; Candice LeRae battles Jacy Jayne, and Los Americanos tangles with the LWO on WWE Main Event.
Carmelo Hayes battles Axiom, and Dragon Lee takes on Rusev on WWE Main Event.
Lizzy Rain's WWE Main Event debut as she takes on Ivy Nile, plus Je'Von Evans takes on Grayson Waller.
Thea Hail takes on Ivy Nile, The LWO Battle DarkState, and Matt Cardona contends against Ricky Saints on WWE Main Event.
Giulia battles Kiana James, Wendy Choo tackles Ivy Nile, and Sean Legacy and Dorian Van Dux take on American Made on WWE Main Event.
WWE Women's Speed Champion Wren Sinclair faces an unstable Lyra Valkyria, Carmelo Hayes battles Ricky Saints, and The LWO take on Harlem Lewis and Harley Riggins on WWE Main Event.
Evolve's PJ Vasa takes on Ivy Nile, Axiom faces Ricky Saints, and American Made battles Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno on WWE Main Event.

NXT's Jaida Parker collides with Lyra Valkyria, Fraxiom battle Tama and Talla Tonga (with Haku in their corner), and American Made tangle with Uriah Connors and Stacks of Birthright on WWE Main Event.
Three matches were scheduled to air but the broadcast ended after one in which Giulia faced Michin.
Akira Tozawa takes on Jasper Troy, Wendy Choo battles Maxxine Dupri.
Matt Cardona goes one-on-one with Kit Wilson. Fraxiom tangle with AAA Tag Team Champions The War Raiders in a non-title match.
Big Cass looks to dominate Brooks Jensen and The LWO face Viktor Zanov and Shido Ash.
Joe Hendry battles Ethan Page, Kyoki faces Kit Wilson, and the LWO clash with Alpha Academy on WWE Main Event.
Big Cass duke it out with Josh Briggs, AAA Tag Team Champions The Wagner Brothers collide with The LWO and Fraxiom face Aero Star and Laredo Kid on WWE Main Event.
Otis takes on NXT's Naraku, Kyoki battles Axiom and Maxxine Dupri tangles with Chantel Monroe on WWE Main Event
Shinsuke Nakamura battles The Miz, Big Cass looks to dominate Sean Legacy, and Maxxine Dupri faces Andi Summers on WWE Main Event.
